experiment: Can an AI-operated editorial website generate net profit?

measurement_rules.revenue: Only verified AdSense finalized earnings, never impressions or estimated traffic revenue
measurement_rules.profit: Verified revenue minus hosting, domains, tools, content and other incremental cash costs
measurement_rules.traffic: GSC clicks and impressions compared over equivalent non-overlapping periods
measurement_rules.ai_visibility: Track separately; impressions are not clicks, citations, or revenue
measurement_rules.decision: Continue, change approach or stop after six months using measured net profit and trend

changes.note: Removed inherited homepage canonical and added homepage main landmark
Expanded 500 sq ft page for high-impression search intent
